instagram.caption:
Whose bathroom is this really.
The Guest Vanity Counter in the Guest Bathroom. It gives a visitor somewhere to wash their hands and set a phone down, with nothing of yours in the way.

What done looks like:
1. A soap pump above half full
2. One folded hand towel on the ring where you can see it from the doorway
3. A box of tissues at the back corner
4. Enough bare counter to set down a phone

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success guest vanity counter.
